svg.aria-label: How sage works: you send a request to the chief of staff, the hooded toad sage, which briefs the team (design, build, review, QA) and keeps the logbook. Findings and QA failures go back to the build. A clean result becomes a pull request. In the outer loop, the chief seals the lesson: a mistake that comes back twice gets a lasting fix, a test or a check in code first, a principle or a standing order only when code cannot hold it.
